cases.title: R08 control A: pit clicked with the real mouse and NO runner read between U and REDO
cases.plan_item: BUG-861 control arm (R08 hardening, spec C32)
cases.expected: The control round (no pick) says 'Everything has been redone'. Then LINE, U, one blind real-mouse click on pit P3 (no AutoCAD read before or after the click), 12 s, REDO. After REDO the pick-first set is read, to prove the pit really was picked. The result is counted, not judged.
cases.why_not_unit: Whether REDO survives depends on what happens in a real AutoCAD undo stack in the seconds after a pick.
not_automated: This is a control arm for the R08 question only; it is not a feature test and is never accepted.
